scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --locked -p russian-roulette-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir public/wasm --out-name russian_roulette_wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/russian_roulette_wasm.wasm
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:wasm && vite build --base=./ && node scripts/assert-pages-build.mjs
